purpose: Compare the official DINO-WM Wall GDPlanner with a planner-call observation-prefix cache while retaining the action-gradient suffix.

model.parameter_grad_reason: GD optimizes actions only; disabling parameter accumulation keeps the paired baseline/cache comparison fair while dL/daction remains live.

gd_settings.source_note: Official mpc_gd.yaml values; this validation calls one direct GDPlanner plan per frozen observation and does not add MPC outer rounds or environment evaluation.

timing.measurement_unit: one complete GDPlanner.plan call for one fixed Wall observation/goal pair
timing.timing_boundary: planner.plan entry through returned actions, including preprocessing, goal/start prefix encoding, optimization, and trace logging
timing.device_synchronization: torch.cuda.synchronize immediately before and after each timed call

decision_gate.fallback: If any recorded decision trace is not bitwise exact, accept only when every final-action and per-step-loss max-abs difference is <= 1e-5.
decision_gate.decision_trace: final actions and one loss value per GD optimization step
decision_gate.action_gradient_requirement: cached start prefix is detached; action encoding, predictor calls, action replacement, objective, and backward path remain live

progression_gate.purpose: Authorize a later PushT transfer only when the Wall GD portability result is both numerically safe and materially useful.
progression_gate.decision_required: decision gate PASS (bitwise exact or every frozen max-abs comparison <= 1e-5)
progression_gate.timing_statistic: median technical-repeat latency per observation, then median of the two paired reductions; reduction = 1 - iteration_cache / baseline
progression_gate.rule: PASS only when decision gate passes, paired median full-plan latency reduction >= 0.10, and maximum cached-to-baseline peak-memory ratio <= 1.10. Otherwise do not progress to PushT.

prohibited: Do not change checkpoint, Wall observation generation, objective, GD settings, or paired RNG seeds between paths.
Do not include environment rollout in the timed planner call.
Do not tune the numerical threshold after seeing results.
Do not use hashes as a substitute for recorded decision comparisons.
